blocks.text: 1. Resumen de las formas del futuro

head: Forma
Uso
Ejemplo
rows: will
predicción, decisión del momento, promesa
I think it'll rain. I'll help you.
going to
plan, predicción basada en el presente
I'm going to move. Look, it's going to fall!
present continuous
plan acordado
I'm meeting the boss at ten.
present simple
horario, programa
The plane lands at quarter past six.
will be + -ing
en curso en un momento del futuro
This time tomorrow I'll be lying on the beach.
will have + participio
terminado antes de un momento del futuro
By Friday I'll have finished the report.

blocks.label: verbo regular
examples: Will you have finished by Monday?
She'll have finished her degree by June.
En junio habrá terminado la carrera.
We'll have finished the house by spring.
En primavera habrán terminado la casa.
You'll have finished the course by then.
Para entonces habréis terminado el curso.
They won't have finished before Christmas.
No habrán terminado antes de Navidad.

blocks.text: El future continuous es el estaré haciendo del español: Don't call at eight; I'll be having dinner. (No llames a las ocho; estaré cenando.) También sirve como pregunta educada sobre planes: Will you be using the car tonight? (¿Vas a necesitar el coche esta noche?)

blocks.title: by = para, como muy tarde
blocks.text: Con el future perfect va a menudo by: by Friday = para el viernes, by the time you arrive = para cuando llegues. No uses until ni for: Lo tendré terminado para el viernes = I'll have finished it by Friday, nunca until Friday. Y después de para cuando, present simple: by the time you arrive, no will arrive.

head: Forma
Ejemplo
Español
rows: be about to
Hurry up, the train is about to leave.
El tren está a punto de salir.
be due to
The meeting is due to start at nine.
Está previsto que la reunión empiece a las nueve.
be likely to
Prices are likely to rise.
Es probable que suban los precios.
be bound to
You're bound to pass. You've worked so hard.
Seguro que apruebas.
be on the point of
She was on the point of leaving.
Estaba a punto de irse.

blocks.text: Para mirar al futuro desde el pasado se usa was going to y would: I was going to call you, but I forgot. (Iba a llamarte, pero se me olvidó.) She knew she would miss him. (Sabía que lo echaría de menos.)

rows: At ten tomorrow I will lie on the beach.
At ten tomorrow I will be lying on the beach.
En curso en un momento: will be + -ing.
I will finish it until Friday.
I will have finished it by Friday.
Como muy tarde: by, con el future perfect.
The train is about leaving.
The train is about to leave.
be about to + verbo.
When I will arrive, I'll call you.
When I arrive, I'll call you.
Después de when: present simple.
I wanted to call you, but I forgot it.
I was going to call you, but I forgot.
Un plan en el pasado: was going to.
Prices are likely rise.
Prices are likely to rise.
be likely to + verbo.

blocks.text: Completa con la forma de futuro correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: This time next week I ______ in Spain.
items.full: This time next week I will be skiing in Spain.
By 2030 they will have built the new bridge.

items.q: Quick, the film is ______ to start!
items.full: Quick, the film is about to start!

items.q: The plane is ______ to land at six.
items.full: The plane is due to land at six.

items.q: I'll have finished the report ______ Monday.
items.full: I'll have finished the report by Monday.

items.q: Don't phone at seven. I ______ dinner.
items.full: Don't phone at seven. I will be having dinner.

items.q: I ______ going to visit you, but my car broke down.
items.full: I was going to visit you, but my car broke down.

items.q: She's very talented. She's ______ to win.
items.full: She's very talented. She's bound to win.

items.q: By the time you get home, I ______ to bed.
items.full: By the time you get home, I will have gone to bed.

items.q: ______ you be using the car this evening?
items.full: Will you be using the car this evening?

items.q: Para el viernes habré terminado el informe.
items.a: I'll have finished the report by Friday.

items.q: Mañana a estas horas estaré tumbado en la playa.
items.a: This time tomorrow I'll be lying on the beach.

items.q: El tren está a punto de salir.
items.a: The train is about to leave.
I was going to call you.
